intro: Across 37 articles spanning 2026-04-12 to 2026-10-16, ZCyberNews coverage of credential theft has tracked AccountDumpling, APT41, and Bluekit alongside vulnerabilities including CVE-2021-47928 (CVSS 8.2), CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, CVE-2025-55182, and CVE-2025-9501. The reporting spans technology, software development, cloud services, financial services, and government, with incidents recorded globally and specifically across Europe, North america, Bangladesh, and Florida. Severity across the tag skews high, with 28 high-severity items, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 1 informational.
